column1: # The libraries Ratchet & Clank (NTSC-U) calls, by entry point, and what the port does with
# each: the same columns and port values as port/game/rac1-pal/libraries.tsv, whose rows
# these are, carried to this version's addresses through the version map
# (port/tools/versionmap; README.md). The symbol is what the NTSC decomp calls the function
# at that address (its names are not always the library's); the notes keep PAL's symbol.
# A row of rac1-pal's whose host C this game does not have yet is not here.
#   host: the port writes it: the shared replacement of that name
#   game: the decompilation's C runs as it is (it only computes).
#   wrap: the decompilation's C runs, as <symbol>__game, under a host function (host/*.c).
#   todo: needs a host version that is not written yet; it stays a stub.
